create_azure_blob_storage_logger: create an AzureBlobStorageLogger instance to asynchronously log LLM events to Azure Blob Storage
async_log_success_event: async_log_success_event logs a successful LLM call payload to the Azure Blob Storage queue
async_log_failure_event: async_log_failure_event logs a failed LLM call payload to the Azure Blob Storage queue
async_send_batch: async_send_batch flushes all queued log payloads from memory to Azure Blob Storage
async_upload_payload_to_azure_blob_stora: async_upload_payload_to_azure_blob_storage uploads a single log payload to Azure Blob Storage via the 3-step REST API process
